page.title: Apartlino — rental management and booking calendar
page.description: Booking calendar with iCal sync for Airbnb and Booking.com, automatic cleaning tasks and accounts for your whole team. Works as a phone app too.
page.h1: Apartlino — calendar, cleaning and team in one place
body: Apartlino runs bookings for several apartments from a single calendar. Dates from Airbnb and Booking.com are pulled in over iCal sync, so there are no double bookings and no copying dates by hand.
When a guest checks out, the cleaning task is created automatically and shows up for whoever cleans. Every team member has their own account and sees only what they need.
features: iCal sync with Airbnb and Booking.com
Accounts for the whole team, with separate permissions
Works as a phone app, with nothing to install from a store

page.title: Apartlino — upravljanje apartmanima i rezervacijama
page.description: Kalendar rezervacija s iCal sinhronizacijom za Airbnb i Booking, automatski zadaci čišćenja i nalozi za cijeli tim. Radi i kao aplikacija na telefonu.
page.h1: Apartlino — kalendar, čišćenje i tim na jednom mjestu
body: Apartlino vodi rezervacije za više apartmana iz jednog kalendara. Termini s Airbnba i Booking.coma se uvlače preko iCal sinhronizacije, pa nema duplih rezervacija ni prepisivanja datuma rukom.
Kad gost ode, zadatak čišćenja se napravi sam i vidi ga osoba koja čisti. Svaki član tima ima svoj nalog i vidi samo ono što mu treba.
features: iCal sinhronizacija s Airbnbom i Booking.comom
Automatski zadaci čišćenja nakon odjave gosta
Nalozi za cijeli tim, s različitim pravima
Radi i kao aplikacija na telefonu, bez instalacije iz trgovine
